checkpoint.title: Route 10 south to Lavender Town's Pokemon Center
notes: Route 10 south of Rock Tunnel (Route10 map.json) to Lavender Town's Pokemon Center. It has no grass. Carol (7, 60) and Clark (4, 62) look around, Trent (4, 68) looks west and Herman wanders row 70 (13..17), looking west and east (sight 2, to x 19): the way keeps to the east side, columns 17..21, and crosses row 70 on column 21. The ledges of row 62 leave a gap at (18, 62); row 66's leaves (21, 66). Row 74's ledge (11, 74) is hopped, and the hold south goes on over the connection into Lavender Town to the wall (11, 9). West of the Center's building, the wall (8, 9) sets the door's column.
